chapter: Studio recordings of the late twenties and thirties
title: Bunny Berigan and the Saturday Night Swing Club
summary: Morehouse remembers Berigan only as a person; Hutto asks about the Swing Club with Leith Stevens.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Do you remember him as a person?
Can you remember anything about him? Do you remember him at all, I mean as far as being a person?
Well he was a person, yeah.
What kind, was he an easy going guy or a difficult guy or do you remember anything about him?
Do you remember talking to him?
Yeah, I remember talking to him but I forget what it was.
Was he ever - were the two of you ever on the Saturday Night Swing Club at the same time?
Yeah, yeah, Saturday Night Swing Club.
And Lee Stevens. Do you remember?
